deadline.value: Chemistry gives January 2 for full consideration of international PhD applications.
deadline.quote: January 2: For full consideration of international applications

also.quote: November 28: For full consideration for the Timothy R. Donoghue Graduate Scholarship

gre_general.value: Chemistry says the GRE is not required.
gre_general.quote: GRE is not required, but your GRE scores may make your application stronger.

gre_subject.value: The Chemistry page says the GRE is not required, so no Chemistry subject score is needed.
gre_subject.quote: GRE is not required, but your GRE scores may make your application stronger.

toefl_min.value: Chemistry asks for TOEFL iBT (MyBest) 80 or more, with at least 22 in speaking; this is higher than the Graduate School's rule.

ielts_min.value: Chemistry asks for IELTS 6.5 overall, with at least 7 in speaking.

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to contact a professor, but are not bound to work with that professor.
supervisor.quote: You are encouraged to contact a professor, but this does not mean you must work with the professor.

funding.value: Chemistry PhD students are supported as teaching or research assistants, with a stipend and tuition covered.
funding.quote: Our graduate students are supported as either graduate teaching assistants (GTAs) or graduate research assistants (GRAs).

entry_route.value: Domestic students usually enter after a bachelor's; international students may enter after a bachelor's or master's.
entry_route.quote: domestic students typically enter directly after the BS; international students may enter after receiving a BS or MS depending on what is most common for their countries.

notes: Chemistry page's TOEFL (MyBest) 80 and IELTS speaking 7 are stricter than the Graduate School's table. Nov 28 date is the Donoghue scholarship round.
